callouts.note: More than 10 LSI chiplets with TSV, Cu interconnect and eDTC; one drawn per die-to-die edge
LSI-1: dual-damascene Cu/USG, L/S 0.8/0.8 um, 2 um thick; LSI-2: SAP Cu/PI, L/S 2/2 um, 2.3 um
TIV 50 um at 100 um pitch (6x TV): direct substrate-to-die path, lower insertion loss than TSV
Reconstituted interposer 43 x 58 mm (~2500 mm2, 3x reticle); one RDL per face
6x SC-RDL variant: 6 back-side RDL layers at 11/11 um; uBGA at 500 um pitch, ~200 um layer with 45 embedded IPDs
3-2-3 substrate with 1400 um core (6x TV); BGA pitch 1000 um
Lid 2000 um (6x TV); film-type TIM between lid and CoW die
F/S RDL vias land on the TIV tops and on the LSI top Cu vias (u-bump to TIV and LSI routing, row L03); mock-up stacking
TSV in the LSI Si lands on M1 and exits at the RI back face onto the B/S RDL (fig ectc51909.2023.00174-f03 / -f05)
die-to-die wires run in the LSI Cu levels under the HBM-SoC gap; lane count not reported (mock-up layout)
3 build-up Cu levels per side (6x TV substrate); microvias stacked over the plugged PTH (fig ectc51687.2025.00148-f01); build-up dims are analogs
core through holes with Cu wall and resin plug; hole, pitch, land and wall are analogs (2.5D-TV substrate, 4-2-4 FCBGA TV)

callouts.note: Si bridge 2.5 x 3.2 mm, 60 um thick, thinned (from 200 um in cavity DBHi) so it fits under the C4 standoff; no laminate cavity
30 um-pitch solder joints, more than 7000 on one bridge; the other QCM bridges use 75 um
chip-bridge-chip sub-assembly first (mass reflow), then the tile is joined to the laminate like a single chip
Cu-pillar C4: 100 um pillar + solder cap, 110 um chip-to-laminate spacing, 150 um pitch; nearest C4 about 250 um from the bridge edge
4 main chips 19 x 19 mm tiled by 4 bridges; chip gap 150 um (DBHi module)
Standard cavity-free laminate, 67.5 x 67.5 mm (QCM); 2000 um thick in the DBrM module; signal routing allowed under the bridge (L/S 9/12 um)
DBrM: chips edge-glued first (clearance down to 25 um), then a 3.35 x 2.5 mm bridge with 30 um-pitch bumps is attached
Chip-to-chip wires in the bridge signal levels between the uC4 fields of adjacent chips; bridge levels and L/S are EMIB analogs (no DBHi row describes the bridge wiring); mock-up layout
Bridge face up: pad level, 2 signal + 2 Vss plane levels (EMIB M1-M4 analog), Si below; the 30 / 75 um uC4 land on the pad level
Cu-plated, resin-plugged through holes with Cu caps; diameter, pitch, land and wall are analogs (see tooltip)
8 Cu levels per side; plane levels L3/L5/L7 and L12/L14/L16 after the Cu ratios of an 8-2-8 analog (ectc51529.2024.00265-a-L07 feature); mock-up assignment
filled laser microvias stacked under the C4 field, lateral jogs on L2 / L8 / L11 / L17 to reach the PTH and BGA pitch (mock-up)
